summary.timeout: Nothing changed in {{seconds}} s. Call specrails_wait again with the cursor; this is not a failure.
summary.interrupted: The person sent a new message; the wait ended early.
reason.stuck: The current step stopped producing activity.
reason.failed: It failed; diagnose it or choose a remedy.
reason.budget: A spend cap was reached; raise it or wait for the reset.
reason.blocked: It is blocked until you act.
warning.cursor_reset: The cursor belongs to another journal; waiting from now on.
warning.gap: Older events were removed by retention; the page starts at the oldest kept event.
error.too_many_refs: Wait for at most {{max}} refs at once.
error.kind: A wait cannot follow {{kind}} refs. Supported: {{kinds}}.
notice: {{ref}} needs you. Call specrails_wait(until) or open it.
